label_info_only: (info only, not part of the grade)
clipped: No grade: {n} clipped samples in the groove. This is a fault of the recording (gain), not of the record. Record again at a lower level.
weighted: Weighted: {weights} (the worst single grade would be {worst}).
f_without_skip: {label} is above the G limit, but the side plays through without skipping: G. F is only given when the stylus skips back.
secondary_penalty: {label}: {grade}, which costs one step. The grade comes from the music; pauses cost at most one step.

skipped_back.one: F: the stylus skipped back once (groove repeated).
skipped_back.other: F: the stylus skipped back {n} times (groove repeated).

uncalibrated: Limits not calibrated yet: the grade is a rough estimate.
floor_applied: Clicks and crackle in quiet passages are reduced by the turntable baseline ({clicks} clicks, {ticks} crackle per minute in the silent groove of the test record).
